prompt:
We had a content distribution job run yesterday that went sideways. The job was supposed to publish 8 premium articles to our platform and send a Discord notification, but it only got 5 out of 8 articles out before hitting a network timeout, and then it just... stopped without ever reporting that it finished. No one knew it had failed until hours later.

I need a complete documented record of that run. Pull the details from the raw incident report at `ops/logs/distribution_incident_raw.txt`. The record should show the full lifecycle of the job from start to finish (including that it was mid-way through at one point), make clear which outcome category this falls into given that only 5 of 8 shipped, list the evidence URLs for what actually went out, and document what's still outstanding.

Also, since this was a delayed/incomplete run, we need a proper post-incident log that acknowledges what went wrong and captures a permanent fix so it doesn't happen again. That post-incident record should go into a file called `<YYYY-MM-DD>.md` inside the `memory/` folder, where the date is the date the job actually ran (yesterday). The same file should also track the KPI summary of the run.

Please produce all necessary files now.
